newsitem.title: LEBANON: Solidere shares mixed on lower turnover.
newsitem.headline: Solidere shares mixed on lower turnover.

text.p: Solidere shares were mixed on sharply reduced turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Thursday as A shares fell to $111.875 from $112.125 on Monday and B shares were steady at $115.
Also traded on the exchange were 5,000 shares of Banque Libanaise Pour Le Commerce (BLC) at $11.50, up from Monday's $11.25 when 2,000 BLC changed hands for the first time on the market.
There was no trading on the exchange on Tuesday and Wednesday when it shut down for New Year holiday.
Turnover in Solidere shares fell sharply to 2,207 shares from 34,374 shares on Monday and value was $247,567.5 from $3,865,072.5.
There was no trade in the shares of the four other listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index fell 0.03 percent to 81.75 and the BLOM stock index fell 0.07 percent to 947.48.
